svg.title: What a maintenance round looks like
svg.desc: Animated swimlane of one maintenance round, by actor and phase. You start the round and tick one Decision Table. The Maintainer Lead dispatches workers in their own sessions; PR Triage and Version Scout read GitHub without any prompt. GitHub clicks are yours. The Smoke Tester deploys to the test account after you confirm the cost. Version Scout batches a blueprint's Low-risk bumps on one branch and pushes after one prompt; the Fixer pushes a fix branch the same way; a second confirmation is asked only for High-risk bumps and code fixes. A reminder every 30 minutes has the Smoke Tester run a read-only healthcheck that asks nothing. A passed test ends with your delete-stack command; a failed test is diagnosed read-only and, with your yes, becomes a Fix row for the Fixer in the same round. A private Round Report is written without a prompt.
svg.text: What a maintenance round looks like

g.text: cost cap: the deadline you approved
the rest push on your tick
You start a round with @maintenance-round in the Lead's chat. Nothing runs on a schedule.
Collect: PR Triage and Version Scout read GitHub in parallel and report back. Reads never prompt.
Decide: one Decision Table. You tick what you approve; anything unticked is rejected.
Execute: GitHub clicks are yours. One deploy prompt, one push prompt per branch. Gate B only for High bumps and code fixes.
Check-In every 30 min, read-only. Passed: you delete the stack. Failed: diagnosis, then your yes sends the Fixer in this round.
Report: a private Round Report records every recommendation, your decision and what ran.

svg.text: Your part of this round: one card, two GitHub clicks, two push prompts, one deploy prompt, one delete command. Everything the crew reads, builds, tests or health-checks asks nothing.
